name: Seaflower
source:
A short sapphic visual novel about a selkie who washes up on a remote scottish island and her friend, a total selkie chaser.

[Edited from [url=https://kentishizzie.itch.io/seaflower]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的女同性恋视觉小说，讲述了一只海豹被冲到苏格兰一个偏远岛屿上的故事，以及她的朋友，一个十足的海豹追逐者。

[编辑自[url=https://kentishizzie.itch.io/seaflower]itch.io[/url]]
